invariants.rationale: The cluster method should not return null; it always delegates to execute() which should return a valid HoodieWriteMetadata.
The clusteringInstantTime parameter is likely required to be non-null for clustering operations.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is needed for clustering and should not be null.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStatuses should return a non-null List.
The write statuses list should always have length >= 0.
